svg.title: Indian SEC regional model-core ridge lengths
svg.desc: Three of24 model years provide qualified regional grid traces. Eight of75 method cases pass;67 are withheld. These are upper100m SON model-core grid lengths, not whole-current lengths. Shaded method and resolution spans are not physical uncertainty or annual ranges.

g.text: Indian SEC · regional model-core ridge lengths
Upper 100 m · September–November · HYCOM model · about 65–105°E
Prepared regional estimates. Whole-current length, width and physical uncertainty remain unknown.
Nominal grid length and computed method/resolution span
1995: about 4,700 km · computed span 4,400–4,800 km · 2/3 operators qualified
2010: about 4,900 km · computed span 4,400–4,900 km · 3/3 operators qualified
2011: about 4,700 km · computed span 4,400–4,800 km · 3/3 operators qualified
24 model years;21 have no qualified nominal estimate. Mean-field route also fails continuity.
Colored dots: qualified model years. Gray: withheld. No interpolation across missing years.
The spans combine smoothing and grid sampling choices. They are not confidence intervals or annual extrema.
Chen et al.2022 · doi:10.1029/2022JC018969 · source and all failed traces retained in the frozen report
